hints: Count how many times each uppercase letter appears.
A palindrome can have at most one letter with an odd count; place that letter in the center.
Put half of each remaining count on the left and mirror the left side to form the right.
analogy: Build one half of a mirror, add the possible center letter, then reflect the half.
example: AAAACACBA has A:5, C:2, B:1; put A in the middle and arrange the remaining halves as AAC, giving AACABACAA.
algorithm: Count letters, reject if more than one count is odd, then concatenate each letter count/2 times, the odd letter if present, and the reverse of the first half.
correctness: Matching mirrored positions use equal counts, while the sole odd letter (if any) occupies the center; the count condition is also necessary.
complexity: O(n+26) time and O(n+26) space for the constructed string.
